description.narrative: (Ethiopia): .FY 2018 Family Planning funds.will be used to buy into the PEPFAR mechanism to support comprehensive family.planning for hard to reach key populations, i.e., female sex workers and.adolescent girls and women engaged in transaction sex. This service will be.provided in the community using existing platforms such as drop in centers. These venues are.providing confidential services only to female sex workers. Specifically,.the funds will facilitate peer demand creation, training for service providers,.peer educators and other support staffs, to conduct regular site level.mentoring, etc. .
